name: Shanghai Titan Scientific Co.,Ltd.
summary: Shanghai Titan Scientific Co., Ltd. furnishes essential laboratory supplies and comprehensive support services tailored for scientists and quality assurance professionals. The company caters to diverse laboratory domains such as biomedical research, advanced materials, renewable energy, industrial chemistry, specialty chemicals, consumer product manufacturing, and analytical testing. It achieves this through a multifaceted approach, including proprietary product development, brand stewardship, strategic distribution agreements, and all-inclusive service packages. Founded in 2007, the company's main operations are based in Shanghai, China.
